acct-lifecycle-events.description: Customer success and account lifecycle management: onboarding cases and playbooks, internal plays and success blueprints, engagements and touchpoints, and integrations with Microsoft Dynamics CRM and Zoom.

api-reference.description: Reference documentation for scripting and integration APIs: server-side and client-side JavaScript APIs (GlideRecord, GlideElement, and related classes), Scripted REST APIs, Jelly tags, mobile SDK APIs for iOS and Android, and other API classes used in custom scripts and integrations.

application-development.description: Building custom applications on the platform: Studio and App Engine Studio, application administration and versions, client and server scripts, Creator Studio and Experience generation, the ServiceNow SDK, deployment requests and AEMC, update sets, and Build Agent for AI-assisted app generation.

application-portfolio-management.description: Enterprise Architecture and Application Portfolio Management (APM): the Technology Reference Model (TRM), business capability and process modeling, value streams, digital interfaces and integrations, product capability tracking, and Enterprise Architecture Workspace.

better-together.description: Cross-product integration guidance, ServiceNow's Better Together use cases: combining IT Asset Management with Sourcing and Procurement Operations, Hardware Asset Management with Sustainable IT, risk assessment across Project Portfolio Management and Supplier Lifecycle Operations, and Enterprise Service Management Foundation.

build-workflows.description: Flow Designer and workflow building: workflow activities such as If, Catalog Task, Update Record, and Delete Record, subflows, REST steps, intelligent AI-assisted approvals and approval summarizers, the workflow palette, and Now Assist for Creator.

cloud-governance-suite.description: A single landing page for Cloud Governance Suite.

cloud-observability.description: A single landing page for Cloud Observability: detecting and responding to changes in cloud-native and monolithic applications.

conversational-interfaces.description: Virtual Agent and omnichannel messaging: chat client branding and streaming responses, channel integrations (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Apple Messages for Business, Facebook Messenger legacy, Alexa), Agent Affinity rules, queues and queue triggers, Workflow Studio integration, and conversation history and analytics.

core-business-suite.description: Core Business Suite: a bundled configuration of Source-to-Pay, Human Resources, and Health and Safety foundation applications, with Core Business Suite Analytics, requester experience through Now Assist, and default Workplace Services configuration.

customer-relationship-management.description: A landing and overview publication for the ServiceNow CRM portfolio: Customer Service Management, Field Service Management, Sales CRM, and related industry solutions, covering shared CRM data foundations (Customer Central, Service Model Foundation, product catalog and data), Omnichannel, Partner Relationship Management, playbooks, and self-service portals.

customer-service-management.description: External customer support (CSM): case management, omnichannel routing, account/contact/consumer/household data, self-service portal, workforce optimization, agent experience, AI-assisted service, order operations case management, and post-sale product lifecycle (MACD) workflows for sold products, with ITSM integration.

delta-washingtondc-australia.description: Consolidated release notes by product, covering everything that changed from the Washingtondc release to Australia. Use this for 'what changed between releases' or upgrade-impact questions.

delta-xanadu-australia.description: Consolidated release notes by product, covering everything that changed from the Xanadu release to Australia. Use this for 'what changed between releases' or upgrade-impact questions.

delta-yokohama-australia.description: Consolidated release notes by product, covering everything that changed from the Yokohama release to Australia. Use this for 'what changed between releases' or upgrade-impact questions.

delta-zurich-australia.description: Consolidated release notes by product, covering everything that changed from the Zurich release to Australia. Use this for 'what changed between releases' or upgrade-impact questions.

employee-service-management.description: HR Service Delivery and employee-facing workplace services: HR case management and checklists, campaign management, contract management and metadata extraction, Health and Safety Incident Management, Workplace Service Delivery (space allocation, visitor management, neighborhoods), Content Publishing localization, and predictive intelligence for HR.

environmental-social-governance.description: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) and Operational Sustainability Management: emissions and metric tracking, the Scope 3 dashboard, calculated and automated metric definitions, material topics, and integrations with Workday and Socialsuite.

field-service-management.description: Field Service Management (FSM): dispatch and scheduling through Dispatcher Workspace, Auto Assignment and the Capacity Console, work order and task management, crew and skills management, stockrooms and parts sourcing, time sheets, and virtual conferencing integration.

financial-services-operations.description: Financial Services Operations (FSO) case management: dispute management for Visa, ACH, Nacha, and credit card accounts, claims and fraud scoring, commercial lines underwriting, complaint management, individual and group life servicing, agentic AI use cases for FSO, and document processing.

glossary.description: The ServiceNow AI Platform glossary, defining terms and concepts used across ServiceNow documentation.

governance-risk-compliance.description: Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC/IRM): risk and controls management, policy and compliance mapping including OSCAL, business continuity management (BCP/BCM), audit management, third-party risk and engagements, model risk assessments and validations, and AI-driven regulatory compliance mapping.

government-industry.description: Public Sector Digital Services (PSDS): constituent and household case management, Investigative Case Management, Grants Management, the Social Benefits Playbook, GOV.UK Design System and Developer Toolkit integration, Service Exchange for Providers, and domain separation for government use cases.

healthcare-life-sciences.description: Healthcare Operations and Care Team applications: Care Team Portal and Mobile, appointment scheduling, biomed and facilities service requests, medical device work orders through Healthcare CMMS, EMR integration with Redox, Pre-Visit Management, and agentic care team workflows.

hyperautomation-low-code.description: ServiceNow AI Platform no-code, low-code, and platform developer tools enable you to build and modify apps, automate workflows, and deliver digital experiences. Use this landing page to find products and features for app development on the ServiceNow AI Platform.

impact.description: ServiceNow Impact: Common Service Data Model (CSDM) assessments, guided Jumpstart and TuneUp improvement programs for products like Virtual Agent, Change Management, Predictive Intelligence, and Strategic Portfolio Management, instance monitoring and performance metrics, Scan Engine dashboards, and Data Collection packs for other products.

industrial-connected-workforce.description: Industrial Connected Workforce: Digital Factory Workspace, Industrial Guided Tasks and standards, functional locations, breakdowns and safety incidents, Industrial Knowledge Management, and the Industrial Connected Workforce mobile experience.

industry-products.description: Industry products further extend the value of the ServiceNow AI Platform by productizing data models, frameworks, and workflows to address common experience challenges at scale.

integrate-applications.description: Integration Hub and automation tooling: spokes for third-party services (Google Sheets, Microsoft Intune, Dropbox Business, Jenkins, Azure RBAC), RPA Hub and RPA Desktop Design Studio components, Automation Center and automation request workflows, and Now Assist for Automation Center.

intelligent-experiences.description: Generative AI and agentic platform features: AI Control Tower, AI Desktop Actions, agentic workflows and secondary agents, Now Assist for Document Intelligence, Knowledge Graph tool creation, NLU Workbench, MCP Server Console, and long-term memory for AI agents.

it-asset-management.description: IT Asset Management (ITAM/HAM/SAM): hardware and software asset lifecycle management, asset depreciation and financial transactions, contract entitlements and renewals, Enterprise Asset Management, vendor license optimization (including Microsoft), OT Asset Management, and cloud cost and rightsizing.

it-business-management.description: IT Business Management (ITBM), Strategic Portfolio Management, and Agile: project and demand portfolio management, Agile Development 2.0 and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) planning, Strategic Planning Workspace, Collaborative Work Management (CWM) boards and docs, Test Management, and investment funding.

it-operations-management.description: IT Operations Management (ITOM): discovery and service mapping across cloud, on-prem, and multi-source environments, CMDB and application service configuration, cloud governance, cost management, and account operations, integrations with major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), Agent Client Collector, and Service Observability.

it-service-management.description: ITSM and adjacent IT service delivery: incident, change, and problem management (including CAB and major incidents), Digital Portfolio Management and CSDM alignment, Change Management approvals and DevOps Change Velocity integrations with GitLab and Azure DevOps, Software Asset Management, Service Portfolio Management, and Workforce Optimization for ITSM.

manufacturing.description: Manufacturing industry applications: warranty contracts and claims, product recall campaigns, product non-conformance and Cost of Poor Quality (CoPQ) tracking, sales promotions and dealer management, and Field Service Management integration.

mobile.description: The ServiceNow Mobile Platform: Mobile App Builder and Card Builder, screen and list configuration, push notifications, offline mode and write-backs, mobile device management integrations (Intune, MaaS360), universal linking, and AI Lens on mobile.

now-intelligence.description: Performance Analytics and reporting: Platform Analytics dashboards, KPI and indicator management with targets and thresholds, executive dashboards for roles like CIO and CISO, data visualizations and explorations, data collectors, and text analytics.

now-platform.description: A single landing page describing the ServiceNow AI Platform as an application platform for automating business processes across the enterprise.

operational-technology.description: Operational Technology (OT) Management: OT asset discovery and vulnerability response, Industrial Workspace and Industrial Process Manager, equipment model entities, the Service Graph Connector for Microsoft Defender for IoT, OT change management, and Now Assist for OT Service Management.

order-management.description: Sales Customer Relationship Management (Sales CRM) — the full sell-side product-sales lifecycle: lead and opportunity management, CPQ configuration and pricing, quote management, order capture and fulfillment, inflight order changes and cancellations, post-sale MACD (Customer Life Cycle Management) workflows, contracts and entitlements, and Partner Relationship Management.

platform-administration.description: Instance-level administration: AI Search setup and configuration, email notifications and diagnostics, Multi-Instance Management and Instance Scan, translation management, field types and form configuration, and upgrade and cloning tools in Upgrade Console.

platform-security.description: Platform security and identity: authentication (SSO, OIDC, ADFS, MFA), access control and Access Insights, column-level and field encryption, REST API access policies, certificate and key pair management and signing, and audit management.

platform-user-interface.description: Service Portal and general UI configuration: page and widget layout, list definitions and grouped lists, base templates and themes, header blocks, navigation handlers, form options, Embedded Help, search engine optimization for portals, and Guided Setup with domain separation.

proactive-service-exp-workflows.description: Customer Service Problem Management (CSPM): defining and running service tests and test groups, threshold rules and measure consequences for proactive issue detection, creating service problem cases from the Customer Service Portal or workspace, and southbound integration with external systems.

release-notes.description: Consolidated release notes and patch and hotfix information across ServiceNow applications and releases: individual application release notes (Advanced Work Assignment, Now Assist Center, ITSM Mobile Agent, Care Team Operations, and others), plus periodic patch and hotfix release notes.

retail-industry.description: Retail industry applications: Retail Task Management, in-store audit tasks, multi-store case creation, customer complaint cases, store plan monitoring, and HQ-to-store case tracking.

roles-by-product.description: A reference index of ServiceNow roles organized by product and application, including Advanced Work Assignment, Customer Service Management, Document Intelligence, Knowledge Management, Predictive Intelligence, Service Catalog, Service Portal, and Virtual Agent.

security-management.description: Security Operations (SecOps): security incident response, vulnerability response and exposure assessment, penetration test findings, threat intelligence, and third-party security tool integrations (Splunk, ArcSight, Tenable, McAfee, Netskope, Fortify on Demand), plus cybersecurity risk and compliance dashboards.

service-exchange.description: Service Exchange: cross-instance service sharing between provider and consumer instances, connections and remote tasks, consumer and provider registration and personas, magic links, and the Service Exchange data model.

service-management-for-the-enterprise.description: Facilities and workplace service management: facilities requests and maintenance plans, space management and interactive facility maps, agent auto-assignment methods, campus information, and Enterprise Move configuration.

servicenow-platform.description: A broad set of platform features not covered by a more specific publication: CMDB and Service Graph Connector, API Insights, knowledge management and articles, workflow activities (Task, Queue, Switch, Unlock), catalog item configuration, surveys, and identification rules. Check here when a topic doesn't clearly belong to a narrower publication.

source-to-pay-operations.description: The end-to-end Source-to-Pay (S2P) procurement lifecycle: Sourcing and Procurement Operations (requisition capture via Shopping Hub, punchout), Purchase Order Management (PO lifecycle and exceptions), Supplier Lifecycle Operations, and Finance Case Management.

telecom-media-technology.description: Telecommunications, Media, and Technology (TMT) industry applications: Telecommunications Customer 360, service order decomposition and fulfillment, product offering and sold product management, unified sales and order management, and Now Assist for TMT.

telecom-network-inventory.description: Telecom Network Inventory (TNI): network and equipment inventory management, IP address and subnet allocation, phone number allocation, data center infrastructure allocation, rack and equipment holder modeling, and network topology.

telecom-service-ops.description: Telecommunications Service Operations Management: telecom discovery and discrepancy identification and reconciliation, Service Graph Connectors for network vendors (Cisco Meraki, Fortinet, Nokia Altiplano, Juniper), and router and switch pattern-based discovery.

vocabulary.description: ServiceNow's own canonical-term/synonym reference table: a single page mapping each canonical product/feature term to its known synonyms, abbreviations, misspellings, and US/British spelling variants (e.g. CAB -> change advisory board, CMDB -> configuration management database). Same content across all tracked releases. Useful for resolving an acronym or shorthand term not yet in this skill's own _synonyms.json.
